description: Retrieve one Property Passport in full by the passportId of a search_stays result: every fact the owner states, the photos, and the owner's own booking channels in contact_routes, where the guest books. The Passport follows the schema at https://openstays.ai/passport-schema/latest/passport.schema.json, without the addresses of its own pages.

passportId.description: The passportId of a search_stays result, exactly as returned, or the link of a Passport page that the user gave.

name: get_property_passport

outputSchema.description: One Property Passport: the owner's own facts about a property. Its fields follow the published schema at https://openstays.ai/passport-schema/latest/passport.schema.json, without the addresses of its own pages.

availability.description: Booked dates from the owner's own calendar, when the owner shares one.

cancellation_policy.description: The owner's cancellation terms, when published.

contact_routes.description: The owner's own booking channels, where the guest books, in the owner's order.

information.description: The owner's own notes on amenities, spaces, prices and fees, booking rules and policies.

key_facts.description: Check-in and check-out times, house rules, minimum stay, lowest published price and cancellation category.

passport.description: Name, scope, number of units and where the facts come from.

rates.description: The owner's published rates. Not a live quote.

units.description: Each accommodation unit: type, bedrooms, beds, bathrooms and guests.

title: Get one OpenStays Property Passport
